image_alt: Brooks and Roo Hound Huddle football print dog bandana
what_didnt_work: Nothing yet, but we've only had it a short time. We can't speak to long-term durability, fading, or stitching wear until it's been through more wash and wear cycles.
what_we_tested: Sizing and fit in the XL, how Remy reacted to wearing it, and how the material felt and held up during normal wear around the house.
what_worked: The XL fit great, no adjusting needed. The polyester material is genuinely lightweight and breathable, which matters for a dog who's outside or active. Remy didn't try to scratch it off or pull at it, which is a good sign for comfort.
worth_buying: Yes, based on fit and comfort so far. The material feels good and the XL sizing was accurate. We'll keep an eye on durability over time and update if anything changes.
remys_take: He got excited the moment it went on, though to be fair, he does that with any bandana. The real tell is that he didn't try to remove this one, which he doesn't always extend to every bandana we put on him.
verdict_text: The XL size fit Remy well right out of the package. The material is noticeably lightweight and breathable, and he left it alone instead of trying to paw it off. Too early in testing to speak to long-term durability.
card_summary: Football print bandana from Brooks & Roo. Great fit in XL, lightweight and breathable. Too early to judge long-term wear.
title: Hound Huddle Bandana: Remy's Test Notes
lede: A football-print bandana from Brooks & Roo, tested in the XL size. Remy gets excited any time a bandana goes on, that's just how he is, but this one fit well and he didn't try to scratch or pull it off, which isn't always the case.
description: Remy's Lab tested the Brooks & Roo Hound Huddle bandana in XL. Great fit, lightweight and breathable material, and Remy's usual bandana excitement, just too early to judge long-term durability.

faqs.question: What size did you test?
faqs.answer: The XL (28 in.). It fit Remy well with no adjustment needed.

faqs.question: Is the material comfortable for active dogs?
faqs.answer: Yes, it's lightweight and breathable polyester, good for everyday wear.

faqs.question: Did Remy try to take it off?
faqs.answer: No, he left it alone, which isn't always the case with bandanas.
